rationale: The agent found the flaw. It showed that every test pair has both proteins in training and explained that a model using protein identity would score high by memorizing hub propensity, so it would overstate performance on new proteins. It refused to report such a model and gave a coexpression-only AUROC of 0.652 instead. However, it did not propose a protein-disjoint split, did not report AUROC by how many proteins were seen in training, and did not compute the per-protein baseline.
